source: XKDR India Air Quality Database, source=cpcb_caaqm, parameter=PM2.5
raw_scope: only station-level CPCB CAAQM PM2.5 observations; no Embassy records; no filling or outlier removal

eligibility.tier_rule: A: >=2 represented years, >=70% active-span coverage, >=75% active months >=80% hourly coverage, >=60% Jan-2024–Sep-2025 active months >=80%, and no duplicate, off-hour, null, nonnumeric, or negative records. B: >=1 represented year, >=50% active-span coverage, >=50% active months >=80%; otherwise C. This is a screening tier, not a regulatory grade.

data_quality.hourly_expected_grid: top-of-hour timestamps; only on-hour timestamps count toward hourly coverage

methodology.station_identity: exact XKDR site_NNN station_id; operator cross-referenced by site code to official CPCB CCR PDF where present
methodology.timestamp_timezone: naive IST as documented by XKDR
methodology.hourly_coverage: distinct exact HH:00 timestamps divided by expected hourly timestamps from first to last observed hour inclusive
methodology.monthly_coverage: actual distinct on-hour timestamps divided by active-span expected hours in that calendar month; first/last partial months flagged
methodology.longest_gap: largest internal run of absent hourly slots between adjacent distinct on-hour observations; excludes leading/trailing span
